qualification: Selection from already-published initial-frame gallery images. This is evidence of geometric compatibility with the original alternating-graph prerequisites, not learned controls, a valid route, contact-removal evidence, or completed levels.

source.verification: Lossless PNG tiles decoded to palette indices; SHA256 of the 4096 frame bytes matched each manifest frameSha256. Atlas hashes also matched the manifest.

selection.otherInitialFrames: For 23 nonstandard-palette previews, only color-equality geometry was examined using distinct local labels; no source-index or frame-hash claim was made for those frames.
selection.reason: TU93 has a single repeated square support material, a single repeated square connector material, one exceptional uniform occurrence, and multicolored overlays. Its next two public previews retain the same geometry and remain within the original three-additional-overlay bound. ESCT has a superficially compatible raster but its public description concerns a moving escort and hunters, and two connector materials appear in its initial preview.

method: Use original pure component/sprite descriptions on decoded public initial rasters.
Count only full squares with side 2 through 16 away from the frame boundary.
Find a unique most-frequent phase with at least four support squares at pitch twice their side.
Count equally-sized differently-colored squares at half-step connector phases and exceptional same-footprint overlays.
Count geometric node/link incidence and cardinal singleton marker offsets without assigning an actor, goal, safe route, or action mapping.
unprovenPrerequisites: The common coordinator must acquire actual input-conditioned translations and distinguish the controlled overlay from the other overlays.
The original measurement needs compatible available action refs and observed effectful translations; with no controls it does not emit a route-bearing description.
The original marker precaution is a counterfactual exclusion hypothesis, not an observed reaction law.
Instrumental contact transfer requires a prior actual removal with matching histogram and size, then a departure revealing ordinary support; the initial gallery images supply no such evidence.
The source search bounds, prefix interruption, remaining action budget, and observed terminal conditions must all be respected by a real campaign.
